headline: Concord's clean sheet run ends at Charleston
dek: Concord had let nothing past in two matches before Charleston scored three against them, and no programme in the conference now holds a clean record. Frostburg State, West Liberty and Davis & Elkins are the three sides still unbeaten, and between them they have conceded seven goals in eight matches.
displaced_by: Concord conceded three at Charleston; no programme is now without a goal against, so the standing headline was no longer true

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston's nine goals have come from eight different scorers; no programme has spread its scoring wider.

wire.line: Every programme has now conceded, and only West Virginia Wesleyan are still without a win.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Shawnee State's first win came in their fourth match; they had conceded twelve goals in the three before it.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Frostburg State are unbeaten after four matches but have drawn two of them, and three goals is all they have conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan have scored in each of their three matches and lost all of them, conceding seven goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Josiah Emerson has made twelve saves and conceded two goals for Frostburg State; his save percentage of .857 is the highest of any listed keeper.

findings.label: signal
findings.text: Leyton Collier's twelve shots have produced two goals for West Liberty; no other player on the leaders list has taken more than eight.

last_match.line: The first goals Concord have given up this season; Charleston have found the net in every match they have played.

next_match.line: Shawnee State arrive off their first win of the season; the visitors are not a conference member, so the table is untouched.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
